entity_geography.text: ocx > ===== FILE: files/1337_9461617_unpacked/1_PLI145F Stenography and Transcription Services - Pre-Market Consultation.docx ===== Preliminary Market Consultation (PMC) Provision of Stenography and Transcription Services for Public Sector Bodies 9th November 2026 Introduction As per the Prior Information Notice (PIN) published in October 2026, the Office of Government Procurement (OGP) intends to run a competitive procurement process for the provision of Stenography and Transcription Services in 2026/2027. As part of the procurement process, the OGP is issuing this Preliminary Market Consultation (PMC) document and invites responses from Economic Operators in the stenography and transcription services market. This is a market sounding exercise to obtain market information on the provision of stenography and transcription services to assist in the development and structuring of the upcoming Request for Tenders. This is also an opportunity for market players to provide valuable information to the OGP in respect of any issues or challenges relevant to this market and to submit any suggestions which would enhance the provision of stenography and transcription services for Public Sector Bodies (PSBs) in Ireland. It is not a call for competition. Details of the procurement process pursuant to this

To ascertain the specific measures undertaken by the market to align with Ireland’s Climate Action Plan 2025 to become carbon neutral by no later than 2050 (Climate Action Plan 2025). Background to the Procurement Requirements The OGP is considering the establishment of the most appropriate, responsive, and effective procurement solution for the provision of professional stenography and transcription services to Public Service Bodies. The framework will support the accurate, secure, and timely capture of spoken communications across a wide range of official settings, with services provided by Economic Operators using their skills, experience, expertise, and professionalism to deliver value-added solutions. Services may include stenographic and court reporting, transcription, captioning, inquiry reporting, remote and hybrid hearing support, and secure transcript management for interviews, hearings, inquiries, tribunals, public consultations, committee meetings, disciplinary proceedings, investigations, conferences, workshops, stakeholder engagements, and other official proceedings. Stenography is the process of creating an accurate, verbatim record of spoken words using specialist shorthand techniques and stenotype technology. Qualified stenographe

Transcription services involve the conversion of recorded audio and video content into written records. These services may be provided using traditional human transcription methods, AI-assisted transcription technologies, or a combination of both. Transcripts may be produced in verbatim, edited verbatim, or intelligent transcription formats, depending on the purpose and requirements of the assignment. All transcripts must be subject to appropriate quality assurance measures to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with client requirements. Instructions for Economic Operators Economic Operators are hereby invited to provide responses addressing the foregoing market sounding objectives. These responses will be important sources of information for the establishment of the most appropriate procurement solution, such as information on court-reporting capability, transcription capacity, quality assurance and nationwide delivery models. Le montant de l'avance est fixé à 5,00 % du montant du bon de commande si la durée de son exécution est inférieure ou égale à douze mois ; si cette durée est supérieure à douze mois, l'avance est égale à 5,00 % d'une somme égale à douze fois le montant du bon de commande divisé par cette durée exprimée en mois. Le remboursement de l'avance commence lorsque le montant des prestations exécutées par le titulaire atteint ou dépasse 65,00 % de la part du montant toutes taxes comprises du bon de commande exécutée par le titulaire. Cette information n’aura pas pour effet d’exonérer le titulaire des pénalités applicables, qui restent dues sur décision de l’organisme. Si pour assurer la continuité de service, la solution implique de la maintenance préventive, les opérations seront planifiées afin de ne pas gêner l’activité et les utilisateurs seront avisés 48 heures avant. Le cas échéant, la maintenance intègrera sans surcoût, les évolutions mineures de l’outil, sous réserve de l’acceptation des organismes utilisateurs. La maintenance comprend la main d’œuvre et les éventuels déplacements du titulaire nécessaire au bon fonctionnement de la solution. Une solution d’assistance en cas d’évolutions des besoins des Caf : Les évolutions pourront porter sur un changement de personnel en charge du traitement et un changement de nature et de typologie des courriers. En cas de changement des personnes en charge du traitement des courriers, il est demandé que les modifications d’habilitations soient à la main de l’administrateur de la Caf (pour garantir la réactivité). En cas de changement des courriers type, il est demandé une réactivité dans la réponse à apporter par le prestataire. Un engagement de service est attendu : 3 jours max

ARTICLE 5 : DATE D’EFFET - DUREE DE L’ACCORD-CADRE L’accord cadre est conclu pour une durée d’un (1) an à compter de sa date d’effet, reconductible tacitement une (1) fois pour une nouvelle période d’un (1) an, sans dépasser vingt-quatre (24) mois. Si la Caf de la Seine Saint Denis décide de ne pas renouveler l’accord cadre, elle en informe le titulaire par tout moyen matériel ou dématérialisé permettant de déterminer de façon certaine la date de sa réception, moyennant un préavis d’un (1) mois. Design Team An IDT team has been appointed for the project, the full Project Team members are as follows: SELECTION CRITERIA Works Contractor Suitability The Contracting Authority is seeking a contractor capable of delivering the new works within a live operational fire station campus. Applicants will need to demonstrate experience of working in a live environment and managing working within this environment successfully. Suitability Assessment Process The objective of this is to identify and evaluate Applicants’ that meet the technical and financial capacity, and then to qualitatively assess and rank those who meet the minimum standards. The minimum standards for the assessment criteria are set out in the SAQ documents. An Applicant which fails to achieve these minimum standards will not be given further consideration and the Applicant will be excluded from the competition. The process used in assessing submissions is set out below: Elimination Criteria Initially the Applicant’s personal situation declaration (Appendix A) is reviewed. Construction comprises concrete ground beams on CFA piles, blockwork rising walls, concrete floor slab, metal stud partitions internal walls, insulated composite cladding panels to external walls, pre-cast concrete first floor and roof slab, external double-glazed windows and doors, internal doors and screens, mechanical and electrical services, internal floor, wall, and ceiling finishes, flat roof finish, decoration internally, and associated external works. REPUBLIC OF TAJIKISTAN

TAJIKISTAN DIGITAL FOUNDATIONS PROJECT

Date: November 9, 2026

Assignment Title: Consultancy Service for Advanced Digital Skills Trainings for 1,000 individuals

Reference No.: PIC-TDFP-CS-3

State Institution "Projects Implementation Center for Tajikistan Digital Foundations" of the Executive Office of the President of the Republic of Tajikistan is implementing Tajikistan Digital Foundation Project (thereafter referred to as Project) co-financed by the World Bank and the Swiss Agency for Development and Cooperation (SDC). The total cost of the project is US$46.2 million, of which the IDA grant is $30M, SDC Trust fund is $14.8M and GoTJ share is $1.4M. and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The consulting services (“the Services”) include the Advanced Digital Skills Trainings for 1,000 individuals

 

The consultant will have to perform the following tasks:

Tasks

  • Develop of complementary business soft skills training modules, that will be delivered in Russian and Tajik to enhance participants’ readiness for employment and further skills development.

  • Develop an inclusive outreach and participant selection framework, including eligibility criteria and targeting approaches, to support the participation of youth, NEET populations, women, persons with disabilities, and beneficiaries in line with the inclusion targets defined in the Objective section.

State Institution "Projects Implementation Center for Tajikistan Digital Foundations" of the Executive Office of the President of the Republic of Tajikistan, 59 Shotemur street, Dushanbe.

Section I: Program Overview & Background 1.1 Purpose The Department of the Air Force (DAF), Business and Enterprise Systems (BES) Directorate, AFLCMC/GBGD, is issuing this Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) to identify and acquire an innovative, commercially available Digital Adoption Platform (DAP). This platform will replace the legacy Oracle User Productivity Kit (UPK), which is reaching its official end-of-life. The primary goal of this acquisition is to secure a modern, sustainable, enterprise-ready so

User Productivity Kit (UPK), which is reaching its official end-of-life. The primary goal of this acquisition is to secure a modern, sustainable, enterprise-ready software-guided training and performance-support tool. It must streamline content creation, simplify software adoption, and provide real-time in-application guidance for the DEAMS user base. 1.2 Mission Impact & Capability Gap The current solution (Oracle UPK) represents unsupported software and significant technical debt. Its retirement creates a critical operational gap in how training is conducted across the enterprise. The replacement DAP will modernize training material outputs, provide interactive in-application assistance, and reduce the overall training footprint. This capability is designated as a Criticality (1) — Must Have requirement to support continuous financial and enterprise operations. 1.3 Scope of the Target Environment • User Base: Approximately 26,000+ geographically dispersed personnel across 170+ global locations. • Primary Integration: Stable and proven integration with Oracle e-Business Suite (EBS) (including F orms & OAF pages) and modern web applications. • Target Environments: The DAP must be deployable and tested across both Development (Dev) and Test environments before transitioning to

1.3 Scope of the Target Environment • User Base: Approximately 26,000+ geographically dispersed personnel across 170+ global locations. • Primary Integration: Stable and proven integration with Oracle e-Business Suite (EBS) (including F orms & OAF pages) and modern web applications. • Target Environments: The DAP must be deployable and tested across both Development (Dev) and Test environments before transitioning to Production. 2. Section II: Areas of Interest (AOIs) The Air Force is seeking commercial solutions that address three primary Areas of Interest (AOIs). Proposals will be evaluated on how comprehensively they meet the validated requirements within each AOI: 2.1 AOI 1: Content Authoring & Development • No-Code Content Creation: The solution must provide an intuitive, user-friendly authoring interface that allows non-technical personnel to rapidly record, create, and update application guidance without writing code. • Multi-Format Recording: Authors must have the ability to record user interactions with web-based applications (specifically Oracle EBS) and desktop applications to automatically generate simulations, step-by-step instructions, and videos. Attach. 1 - CSO UPK Problem Statement Page 2 of 5 • Ri ch Content Editing: The authoring tool must provide advanced formattin

at Recording: Authors must have the ability to record user interactions with web-based applications (specifically Oracle EBS) and desktop applications to automatically generate simulations, step-by-step instructions, and videos. For more information on the PEACEPLUS Programme, please visit https://www.seupb.eu/PEACEPLUS Full information on the specification for each project will be given in the Request for Tender document, this document outlines general points about PEACEPLUS and the projects advertised under Theme 1.1 Recruitment and definition of a participant Theme 1.1 requires ‘transformative’ , meaningful, and purposeful cross -community contact. Contact should be worthwhile and have a function; it should result in the participation of shared activities and be of a sufficient intensity to ensure a transformative experience. A participant is not the same as an attendee. For example, if person X attends a combination of four workshops (2 hours each), a conference (6 hours) and a

workshop or event. A participant must also have provided the required registration details and completed the required monitoring and evaluation templates to be categorised as a Participant. It is quite possible that people who are not participants may occasionally attend events under PEACEPLUS Theme 1.1 delivery. If they are not registered and have not completed the required monitoring and evaluation form, they will only be attendees . If they are attending multiple events, the programme delivery agent should get them registered and track their attendance so that they can count as a participant. Programme Monitoring & Evaluation Requirements Following the establishment of baseline data, monitoring and evaluation will be undertaken during and post project, to capture change in perspectives created through programme delivery. This will include: • Attendance sheets for activities delivered illustrating the range of participants. • Pre and post activity evaluation forms tracking qualitative measures of attitude and perception. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 – REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solu

quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 – REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solu

quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVE The Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) Office of Infrastructure Research & Development (HRDI) conducts and oversees research and development programs and projects that address critical highway infrastructure needs and priorities of national importance. Research studies focus on the design, materials, construction, operation, and preservation of highway pavements, bridges, and other structure

rs, engineers, and transportation agencies nationwide through the FHWA InfoHighway™ data portals (https://infohighway.fhwa.dot.gov). FHWA InfoHighway provides centralized access to research-quality infrastructure performance data, supporting data-driven pavement engineering, predictive modeling, and State DOT decision-making. The primary mission of the LPES contract is direct support for the LTPP program, consolidating field data collection, pavement research analytics, and long-term data management; additionally, the contract provides direct and indirect data support to related FHWA infrastructure research programs. 2 OBJECTIVE/SCOPE OF WORK The main objective of this contract is to provide highly specialized engineering services, including field survey operations, data quality management, scientific data curation, and technology transfer support services for the LTPP program and related highway infrastructure research initiatives. earch- grade data quality. • Formulate strategic pavement research plans advancing the LTPP program, conduct targeted performance case studies, and deliver practical engineering tools, Section 508- compliant publications, and technical webinars. • Develop and curate specialized, analysis-ready datasets for machine learning (ML) and predictive modeling across LTPP and broader highway infrastructure domains, integrating modern database architectures and coordinating data schemas with web portal contractors for public release. To fulfill the LTPP program mission and support broader FHWA pavement and other infrastructure research, the scope of work is organized across three (3) primary Task Areas. Contractors are not required to perform across all Task Areas unless awarded task orders in those areas: • Task Area A – Data Collection and Processing: The Contractor shall provide all labor, contractor-owned survey vehicles, specialized diagnostic equipment, materials, and traffic control services necessary to perform automated high-speed 3D surface condition profiling, as well as deflection testing using the Traffic-Speed Deflection Device (TSDD) and Falling Weight Deflectometer (FWD) methods. For the purpose of evaluation only, bidders are requested to propose an annual PR plan based on an indicative out-of-pocket budget of €50,000 excluding VAT per annum. This indicative budget is provided solely to allow for a comparable assessment of proposals. Actual annual implementation budgets, scope and allocation will be subject to approval by the Contracting Authority and may vary during the contract period. For the sake of this exercise, bidders will be assessed for the PR ideas they pitch in the proposed plan for the destination with an out-of-pocket budget of €50,000 excluding VAT. Expenses related to press and influencer hosting in Malta for press and influence trips (travel costs, accommodation, transport and ground handling) should not be factored into this budget, as these are absorbed by a separate and independent budget at MTA head office. A plan proposal for 1 year should be provided, with ideas ranging from special one- off PR projects and promotions in France as well as cross-branding PR & influence opportunities. The ideas proposed must be realistic and feasible, with the possibility to be implemented at the budget cost estimate proposed. The objective of such a plan is to generate and cultivate the best positive exposure in B2B and B2C commu

posure for the Maltese Islands. 5. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 – REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solu

quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. To meet these ESR bunch injection schemes and requirements, an array of stripline-based kickers, individually fed by high voltage (HV) pulse signals of up to +/-30 kV, will be installed in the ESR. The required deflection angle is in the range 1- 1.5 mrad, for the individual stripline kicker we target a deflection angle of ~125 µrad @ 18 GeV, assuming +/-27 kV pulse supply voltage between the kicker electrodes. To keep the losses of the stored beam low, a ~15 σ distance between the stored beam and the injection septa in the ESR must be maintained, which translates into a minimum physical aperture of 30 mm diameter for the stripline kickers. Kõigi viie rolli täitjad peavad olema pakkumuses nimeliselt esitatud ning nende vastavus vastavale rollile kehtestatud nõuetele peab olema tõendatud pakkumuses esitataval meeskonnaliikmete ühise CV vormil. Üks meeskonnaliige võib täita kuni kahte rolli, kui ta vastab mõlema rolli nõuetele. Meeskonnaliikmete esitamisega kinnitab pakkuja, et esitatud meeskonnaliikmed hakkavad riigihanke tulemusel sõlmitud lepingu alusel töid teostama. Pakkumuses esitatud meeskonnaliikme saab hankija eelneval nõusolekul vahetada üksnes uue meeskonnaliikme vastu, kes vastab vormil toodud tingimustele. Üks meeskonnaliige võib korraga olla kuni kahes rollis, kui ta täidab mõlema kaetava rolli tingimused. Meeskonnaliikmete ühise CV vorm CV-s peab nähtuma kõikide hankija seatud nõuete täitmine, hankija kontrollib nõude täitmist esitatud andmete alusel. CV peab olema esitatud eesti keeles. Meeskond tunnistatakse vastavaks, kui kõik CV vormil esitatud nõuded, kompetentsid, platvormid ja töövahendid on meeskonnaliikmete poolt kaetud. Kui tingimuses on nõutud (kõrg)haridus, peab see olema lõpetatud. Pakkujal tuleb märkida kõrghariduse omandamise aasta. Kui tingimuses ei ole nõutud töökogemust projektis, võib viidata ka töökogemuse omandamisele töösuhtes
